title: India just registered a record number of electric two-wheelers in a single month
sources: Autocar India - Indian e-two-wheeler sales crosses a record 2.23 lakh units in October
NewsBytes - India posts 223,886 October electric 2-wheeler registrations, EV share dips
caption:
India just registered a record number of electric two-wheelers in a single month. 223,886 of them, in October alone.

VAHAN registration data shows 223,886 electric two-wheelers registered in October 2026 - up 48% year-on-year and about 7% above September's prior high. TVS led the market with its best-ever month, followed by Bajaj Auto, Ather Energy, Hero MotoCorp and Ola Electric. EVs made up about 9.6% of all two-wheeler sales - a slight dip in share even as absolute volume hit a record, because conventional scooter sales grew even faster this festive season.

A record month, with an honest asterisk.

Sources: Autocar India, NewsBytes, citing VAHAN data (2026)
